deficiency.overview: Deficiency is very rare in the United States. Possible effects on growth, bones and skin are education, not a symptom-based diagnosis.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: Very high manganese levels in drinking water and occupational dust exposure can cause toxicity affecting the nervous system. Exposure contexts are not interchangeable.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Seek professional or medical advice before changing supplement or medication use.

interactions.description: ODS identifies no known medicine interactions for manganese but recommends discussing supplement and medication use with health professionals.
interactions.limitations: Informational summary, not a complete interaction list or an instruction to change medicines.
